tagline: One of the world's great ferry-commute harbours — dense Sydney Harbour network plus the Pittwater and Newcastle edges.
summary: Sydney runs one of the world's most iconic and heavily used public ferry networks across a vast, beautiful harbour: Circular Quay to Manly, Watsons Bay, Darling Harbour, Parramatta River and beyond. This is a genuine mass-transit market with a strong public-transport upgrade case (quiet, zero-emission, fast) alongside premium harbour and northern-beaches charter demand. Almost all legs are inside Pioneer II range; the Pittwater and Newcastle edges extend it. Sydney is also a globally visible flagship harbour.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the entire Sydney Harbour mesh plus the Pittwater and (edge) Newcastle runs.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) could open longer NSW-coast trunks (e.g. Sydney↔Newcastle↔Port Stephens) as scheduled line-haul.

competitive_landscape: A mature mass-market public ferry network (Transport for NSW) plus a deep charter and events fleet. The upgrade case is ride quality, emissions and speed; no foiling incumbent.
seasonality: Year-round operable; peak summer (Dec–Feb) for tourism/charter; harbour generally sheltered; southerly busters bring short chop.
regulatory_note: Australian flag; AMSA certification; Transport for NSW concessions for any public-network integration; Sydney Harbour is a managed waterway (Roads & Maritime / Port Authority of NSW).
